purpose: Reviewed execution/authority evidence only; absent reviews remain unclassified. No automatic reachability claims.

reviews.effect: Read-only projection of legacy log field 'provider' to filterable provider_id; no GET/POST, file write or rights grant
reviews.authority: Observed historic log payload, constrained by logger/category/operation/status/code/loan_id; never business entitlement
reviews.replacement_contract: Canonical structured diagnostic.provider_id for new events; preserve bounded legacy reader for existing logs
reviews.rationale: Removal would lose truthful provider filtering in archived 29/10 loan-sync diagnostics; compatibility is restricted, descriptive and covered by negative tests

reviews.productive_caller: Config initialization for persisted provider accounts, before descriptor attachment
reviews.effect: Rewrites provider identity ownership and directory names on load for more than one Kobo connection in an identity; not a passive read
reviews.authority: Legacy hardcoded provider identity heuristic, not an installed descriptor/cardinality attestation
reviews.replacement_contract: Provider-neutral transactional cardinality migration using installed ProviderDescriptor.max_accounts_per_identity, with durable migration state and no silent borrower rebinding
reviews.rationale: Active supplier-specific configuration mutation must be removed only after v0.8.1 recovery fixtures and descriptor-neutral migrations preserve accounts without fabricating ownership.

reviews.journey: Reuse of initial ACSM staging for one previously admitted loan
reviews.effect: Rejects non-Paris/non-DILICOM/foreign borrower loan provenance before reusing a cached license token
reviews.authority: Exact loan source, credential, owner, borrower, id and edition; current source literal is a veto, never evidence for a right
reviews.replacement_contract: Typed current-loan staging provenance and borrower scope, attested by installed provider and Core after admission
reviews.rationale: Do not remove the Paris-shaped veto while a forged same-account ACSM token could be mistaken for a valid initial staging artifact.

reviews.journey: Local inspection declaration of active BnF Web loan
reviews.productive_caller: LocalInspection.__init__ declared_right_scopes on current entitlement SQLite snapshot
reviews.effect: Allows a descriptive declaration only for one active loan with native nonempty loan_id; no acquisition or attachment permission
reviews.authority: SQLite exact loan row, descriptive only; provider-specific exception is stricter than generic catalogue declarations
reviews.replacement_contract: Provider-neutral typed loan-origin declaration policy in rights observation contract, preserving BnF missing/inactive-ID refusal
reviews.rationale: Converting this veto to a generic rights check without a typed proof would permit non-loan or expired BnF declarations.

reviews.journey: Numilog legacy local manual-pair diagnostic preflight
reviews.productive_caller: LocalInspection.__init__ _manual_right_proofs for detailed readonly Numilog preflight
reviews.effect: Builds local attested/ambiguous/ledger signature evidence only for Numilog; preview remains read-only and rejects all other sources
reviews.authority: Provider-specific legacy receipt attested_source plus exact scope, acquisition ledger and artifact checksum
reviews.replacement_contract: Versioned provider-owned manual-match evidence ABI or retirement of legacy manual pairing with equivalent no-write refusals
reviews.rationale: The diagnostic proof map is an executable supplier branch, but deleting it before a provider-neutral typed replacement would weaken ambiguity/refusal decisions.

reviews.journey: Offline reconciliation of existing purchases, rights and placements
reviews.productive_caller: core.library_reconciliation.reconcile on a local SQLite/WAL image
reviews.effect: Only confirms candidate existing rights with complete ledger, bytes and expected historical attested_source for Kobo or Numilog; never grants a new right
reviews.authority: Canonical exact provider/account/edition/right/Artifact evidence and a bounded whitelist of legacy producer assertions
reviews.replacement_contract: Versioned source-provenance classification map owned by provider contracts, preserving no-evidence/no-assumption behavior
reviews.rationale: The legacy producer whitelist protects private ownership interpretation and cannot be removed by mechanically replacing the literal list.

reviews.journey: Automatic digital-loan admission pre-ADEPT owner and borrower validation
reviews.productive_caller: core.loan_acquisition_admission.resolve called from LibraryService automatic loan acquisition
reviews.effect: Invokes Paris ADEPT borrower-binding guard on an exact bound loan before any matching entitlement is selected
reviews.authority: Durable source identity and borrower provenance plus ADEPT grant; not the current GTK account
reviews.replacement_contract: Generic installed provider borrower-attestation policy with typed denial and same-source immutable admission lease
reviews.rationale: Removing the guard before a supplier-neutral proof would enable cross-borrower ADEPT staging for Paris.

reviews.journey: Direct facade admission for automatic acquisition of Web-observed BnF loan
reviews.effect: Default-denies BnF Web ACSM GET before lock, filesystem, session or provider; explicit manual double confirmation remains separate
reviews.authority: Provider-specific early safety veto in Core, backed independently by BnF ProviderSession.download_digital explicit_user_action contract
reviews.replacement_contract: Fail-closed explicit-only loan acquisition admission capability enforced generically at facade and per-current plugin session, including synthetic dishonest/unknown adapters
reviews.rationale: Opening-sync capability checks alone do not protect direct callers of the facade; must preserve refusal before any I/O while removing supplier discrimination.

reviews.journey: Legacy Kobo W2 manual source-materialization preview/execution
reviews.productive_caller: core.source_materialization._source from SynchronizationBrokerImpl legacy manual materialization route
reviews.effect: Routes only Kobo accounts to legacy backup_items-based confirmation and writer, with special borrower/session/consent checks
reviews.authority: Historical Kobo backup manifest and legacy confirmation token, explicitly superseded for complete canonical A-to-B ABI
reviews.replacement_contract: Canonical typed SourceReference/Offer/Delivery/Placement for exact source; retire remaining W2 writer when all supported scopes are covered
reviews.rationale: Active supplier-specific legacy writer remains executable for partial ABI. Must physically retire it after cutover, without treating an archive as current ownership.

reviews.journey: Schema-v3 migration of historical backup_items into canonical tables
reviews.productive_caller: Storage._migrate on opening pre-v3 SQLite databases
reviews.effect: Skips Kobo v0.7 archive rows to avoid synthesizing entitlements/placements during schema migration while other legacy sources retain their historical replay
reviews.authority: Hardcoded legacy archive-format boundary; no new Kobo right can originate in this migration
reviews.replacement_contract: Versioned per-row legacy provenance policy or separately retired historical migration with tested old-database reopen/rollback
reviews.rationale: This migration branch protects old user databases. It is not a removable active provider GET, but it does still execute on old schema and must be retained until equivalent safe migration exists.

retirements.evidence: The provider-keyed Gtk action branch and BnF-only label were physically removed; Core now inspects the installed exact live session's static ACSM stage profile and methods. Consent, stage and import remain unchanged.
Core brand comparison deleted and replaced by an installed provider's explicit, non-secret, read-only public navigation account option; no new per-provider dispatch in generic Core.

The special Core facade config.paris_base_url() call was deleted; the installed Paris plugin declares base_url/legacy_config_key and the provider-neutral resolver reads only configuration and validates public URLs.
Public identity account enumeration no longer accepts an omitted identity. Blank/invalid identity fails before any storage/account lookup, and a GTK selection switch cannot widen scope.

retirements.replacement: AcquisitionBroker.eligible_accounts(item, *, identity_id: str), exact provider/credential filtering
retirements.evidence: No implicit account enumeration from current GTK identity; ambiguous account IDs and credentials remain guarded before acquisition. ABI now requires caller scope.

The display-only ADEPT activity predicate no longer reads current_identity/current_account/last_loans. It obtains a v2 cache keyed by exact identity/provider/credential/borrower, validates each Loan and requires active status; legacy Entitlement only correlates already-observed exact provider loan, never grants rights. One historical method signature remains a thin delegation.

Confirmed manual local-materialization submits a provider-neutral kind, with identical USER_ACTION, origin=user, progress and cancellation contract; TaskRunner gives the same GLib.PRIORITY_DEFAULT final receipt to this kind. Historical kobo-acquisition strings remain only inert bounded telemetry compatibility (no active producer or privileged scheduling).

Public metadata library projection requires an explicit identity before calling the service or scanning SQLite/files. No fallback to UI current_identity; exact identity is forwarded unchanged. Direct legacy GUI service API is separately retained as a navigation-only compatibility entrypoint.

retirements.original: core.library_projection.refresh_history(account=None) navigation fallback and identity-less history-v3 cache
retirements.journey: History refresh admitted from GUI, CLI and Core facade
retirements.replacement: Pinned Account at facade admission and worker keyword-only; history-v4 hash of unambiguous (identity,provider,credential,account,primary)
retirements.evidence: Worker no longer reads current_account. Cache v4 excludes unsafe identity-less v3 entries and separates two owners with the same upstream coordinates. Invalid scope fails before I/O.

retirements.original: src/cifereca/core/library_projection.py::recent_acquisitions(identity_id=None) derives selected current_identity at read time
retirements.replacement: exact nonblank identity_id at LibraryService/GUI caller boundary, fail-closed [] otherwise
retirements.evidence: Deleted read of current_identity from recent-acquisition projection. Omitted/blank/malformed identity returns before invoking SQLite, placements, loan cache or provider metadata; existing GUI caller already passes explicit identity_id. Historical unowned placement remains scoped to the default identity only when explicitly requested.

retirements.replacement: SyncRequest(identity_id=scope.identity_id) pinned at click; broker.synchronize(request) authorizes each exact source independently
retirements.evidence: After admission the queued worker no longer consults mutable GTK identity, generation, page lifetime or current account. The live SynchronizationBrokerImpl.synchronize validates identity and enumerates enabled connected source refs, then synchronize_source revalidates source and consent. GTK callbacks still call sync_action_scope_current to refuse stale display.
